title: Verify login page mobile behavior in production environment
body: Issue #2505 could not be reproduced locally. The middleware correctly allows /login through without redirect. The bug may be environment-specific (production vs local) or may have been fixed by a recent middleware change (commit f8425fd46 removed /ask from protectedPaths). Need to verify behavior in production environment with actual mobile device testing at 375px viewport.
rationale: The bug was found during QA sweep but cannot be reproduced in local testing. This could indicate an environment-specific issue or a difference between local and production middleware behavior.
